items.headline: Stocks ended last week higher despite a Friday chip sell-off
items.note: On Friday, Nov. 13, the Dow rose 0.1%, the S&P 500 fell 0.4% and the Nasdaq fell 0.9%. For the week the Dow gained about 2%, the S&P 500 about 2.5% and the Nasdaq more than 2%. Today's close wasn't available when this was written.

items.headline: Nvidia reports earnings Tuesday after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation
items.note: An 8-K says the board accepted Huang's resignation on Nov. 11 and named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO; Harvey Jones is board chair. Options were pricing a move of about 10.6% either way, and consensus revenue is about $108.8 billion. Nvidia's results set the tone for AI hiring and valuations.

items.headline: Nvidia's board is investigating allegations involving Huang
items.note: MarketPulse, citing Reuters, says the board opened an independent probe over allegations about a relationship with a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed. No findings have been reported. The stock fell 4.3% on Nov. 9 and its market cap has dropped almost 30% from its October peak.

items.headline: AMD, Broadcom and Intel also sold off Friday
items.note: In live updates AMD fell roughly 9%, Broadcom about 6% and Intel about 5%, so the weakness spread across AI chip stocks.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO roadshow is underway at $70–$78 a share
items.note: Anthropic is offering about 825 million shares on Nasdaq under ANT, plus a $26 billion private placement from AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC Partners. The pricing date isn't in the filing details I read; reports point to later this week.

items.headline: Hot producer prices keep Fed rate-hike pressure on
items.note: October producer prices rose 0.3%, below the 0.4% expected, but the 6.5% annual rate is the highest since November 2022. The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.17%, its highest since October, after a bond sell-off driven by oil. Higher yields tend to weigh on tech stocks.

items.headline: Volatility is creeping up: VIX above 20 and Bitcoin under $70,000
items.note: The VIX climbed above 20 in morning trading Friday and Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time in nearly three months, both signs of investors getting more cautious.

items.headline: Data science demand holds up even as tech layoffs continue
items.note: Toptal's Q3 2026 report shows two straight quarterly declines in tech layoffs, and its data science index rose 3% year over year though it fell 10% from the prior quarter. Worth knowing as you plan 2027 internship applications.

learn.term: Implied move (what options say about earnings)
learn.explain: Before a big report, traders buy and sell options, and the prices of those options reveal how large a stock swing the market expects. That expected swing is called the implied move. For Nvidia's report, options were pricing roughly a 10.6% move up or down, versus a 10-year average near 7.8%. It says nothing about direction, only size, so a smaller actual move can still disappoint people who expected more. A high implied move means investors see unusual uncertainty, here the CEO change and board probe.
